detailed_description: The Boxplot Chart Generator helps you compare distributions across several groups in a compact visual. It is useful when you want to discuss spread, median position, and unusual values without showing every raw row in a table. You can enter grouped data, switch the orientation, tune labels and colors, and review the chart preview before exporting a PNG or SVG for analysis notes, classroom material, or internal reports.
usage_steps: Add the grouped values you want to compare, keeping each dataset clearly labeled in the editor.
Choose the chart orientation and adjust the title so the comparison is easy to understand at a glance.
Refine axis labels, colors, and visible markers until the distribution summary is readable.
Review the preview to confirm each group appears in the expected order and scale.
Export the finished boxplot as PNG or SVG for reports, presentations, or study material.
usage_examples: Compare exam score distributions across several classes in an education report.
Show delivery time variation between warehouses or shipping methods.
Review differences in response time ranges across product versions or support queues.
